York Simplicity Question
Hi folks. I have a bunch of 6ton packaged RTUs im servicing. (2nd yr apprentice)

All of them have the york simplicity board

Manual here: http://www.upgnet.com/Site/Catalog/PDFFile.asp?f=1136326-USG-C-0216.PDF

because its cold out, when I jump the units into cooling it is staying in economizer mode. I am just curious if anyone knows if it is possible to run a test on heating and cooling through this software on these boards. Seems crazy that they would make this board and not give the technician the ability to test the unit in heating and cooling.

The only option I can see is system test and it doesn't do what I need it to do, in fact I am not sure what it is doing.

Thanks in advance folks.
